### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page, while `/widgets` loads it.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly, so the final slash in `/widgets/` blocks a match. Removing that final slash in a local test made the page load.

### How to fix it

Remove the final slash from an address before comparing it, so `/widgets` and `/widgets/` both open the page. This is a small change in one comparison, plus a test that repeats the failing address to check it stays fixed. Choose hotfix because the change is small and safe.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the sectioned contract and fixes the plain-reader register that Before missed (Before leaned on shorthand like 'failed to falsify the missing-normalization hypothesis', 'tracked baseline', 'no delta at checkpoint 2', and a bare `src/router.ts:88` with no explanation of normalization); After names the matcher by its role, explains 404, and shows the trailing-slash test as proof. Two things worth tightening in the wording: first, After's reporter draft no longer has a visible boundary — Before used 'Here is the full draft:' plus a blockquote, so a reader knew exactly what text would be posted, whereas After runs the three sections straight into 'Reply `send it` to post this comment' with nothing marking where the draft ends; the contract should require an explicit 'Draft:' lead-in and a closing line (or indentation/blockquote, since blockquote is not a fence) so the confirmation is unambiguously outside the draft. Second, After dropped the router location entirely from the gate; since the recommended pick is 'implement hotfix now', the implementer's next action does require opening that file, so the 'omit implementation citations unless the next action requires opening them' rule should be phrased so that a hotfix recommendation keeps one trailing location citation (e.g. '...before comparing it (the comparison in the router, `src/router.ts:88`)') rather than reading as 'drop citations by default'.

Nothing Before kept was lost, but two drifts are worth tightening in the wording: After fenced the menu as a ```text block and flipped row 3 to [x], which is unrequested and risks a future no-fence or menu-intact reading, so state that the menu stays unfenced with [ ] boxes and only the [recommended] tag marking the pick; and After dropped `src/router.ts:88` entirely, yet the recommended next action is a hotfix, so the contract should say the location trails the How to fix it claim when the pick requires opening it (e.g. "...before comparing page addresses (`src/router.ts:88`).").
